5f9d64571b4d3a64.description: The Senior Engineer I is responsible for the activities related to an assigned organizational element, program, project, or task. These projects, by nature of their complexity and difficulty, require the fully competent application of conventional knowledge in a particular engineering or scientific field. Project work and assignments may be broad, requiring ingenuity and cross-functional coordination. What You Will Do: - Provides day-to-day leadership of Engineering staff assigned. Assigns projects to Engineers and monitors the progress of all assigned projects. Ensures the delivery of high-quality service and maintenance of good customer relations. - Devises new approaches to problems encountered and makes recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or design where necessary. - Monitors the technical quality, content, consistency, continuity, and timeliness of action of all assigned projects. - Applies intensive and diversified knowledge of engineering principles and practices in broad areas of technical responsibility. Performs engineering reviews and analyses when necessary. Reviews other engineers' work and provides appropriate guidance and training when necessary. - Participates in the development and changes of Rules. Advises assigned staff in matters related to the application of Rules and Regulations. - Prepares written responses to clients in accordance with established procedures. - Maintains liaison with other engineering specialists internally and externally. - Monitors the performance, development potential, and training needs of engineers assigned. Keeps management informed of manpower needs. - Develops or assists in the development of qualification statements, proposals, bids, and other presentation materials. What You Will Need: Education and Experience - B.S. degree in Civil, Structural Engineering, Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or other related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred - The following are new hire requirements for university graduates and experienced engineers from the industry: - Graduate from University and a minimum of five (5) years of related experience. For those with Hull backgrounds - B.S. degree in Civil, Structural Engineering, Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or other related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred - Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software - Exposed to Finite Element Method (course work or supervised research) - Professional or chartered engineer license - At least ten (10) years of related engineering experience in a shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society; or two (2) years as an Engineer II. For those with Machinery backgrounds - B.S. degree in Marine, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering or other related disciplines - At least ten (10) years of related engineering experience in a shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society; or two (2) years as an Engineer II. - Seagoing engineering license or professional/chartered engineer license. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities - Should have advanced practical industry-related experience. - Knowledge of related technical disciplines. - Knowledge of applicable Rules and Regulations and the impact of Rule applications and interpretations. - Knowledge of company business policies and procedures. - Strong knowledge of emerging technologies and innovation trends, including AI, digitalization, robotics, and data analytics, with the ability to evaluate their technical feasibility, benefits, and applications. - Experience leading or supporting technology development for smart solutions, including digital twins, automation technologies, and robotics initiatives, is an advantage. - The human relations skills necessary to maintain positive client contacts and provide leadership and motivation to subordinate staff and peers. - Ability to identify, analyze and solve complex or unique engineering problems. - Ability to undertake short- and long-term planning to provide for efficient and effective scheduling of work assignments. - Ability to communicate effectively in English verbally and in writing. - Ability to obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. It Would Be Nice If You Had Professional or chartered engineer license. Reporting Relationships: The incumbent Generally reports to a Principal Engineer but may report to others depending on the specific of assignment. This position does not have any direct reports.

5f9c3254ecadaea6.description: About Siemens and the Role Siemens Digital Industries is a leader in automation and digitalization, focused on supporting customers in maximizing growth, profit opportunities, and ecological footprint within the discrete and process industries. We are seeking an OT Cybersecurity Design Engineer to join our team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience. Role Overview The OT Cybersecurity Design Engineer will be responsible for engineering, implementing, and monitoring security measures for Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), their related networks, and information. This role involves defining system security requirements and designing robust cybersecurity architectures in adherence to industry standards and best practices. Key Responsibilities Engineer, implement, and monitor security measures for ICS/SIS systems, networks, and information. Identify and define system security requirements. Design ICS systems security architecture and develop detailed cybersecurity designs based on standard blueprints. Participate in the entire software/system lifecycle, including design, documentation, installation, configuration, and testing. Manage System Backup technologies (*, Acronis), including installation and deployment. Deploy and manage End Point Security & Application Control Solutions (*, McAfee) and SIEM solutions (*, McAfee, Splunk, Q-radar). Implement and manage network-based firewalls (*, Fortinet, Palo Alto, CISCO, SonicWALL, Siemens) and intrusion detection products. Install and manage Network Management Solutions. Conduct firmware updates for Automation Control Systems, Switches, and Firewalls. Configure and deploy Domain Controller settings and policies. Implement host-based security technologies such as Antivirus, Data Leakage Prevention, Host IPS, Whitelisting, and Anomaly Detection. Perform installation, configuration, and testing activities at factory and customer sites, including Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). Prepare comprehensive system documentation, including Functional Design Specifications, Backup Systems documentation, Firewall configurations, Network Diagrams, System Architectures, Asset Inventory, FAT and SAT procedures, and Operation & Maintenance manuals. Required Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of relevant experience in OT cybersecurity design and implementation. Demonstrated experience with ICS/SIS systems security. Proficiency in managing various cybersecurity technologies and solutions. Experience with Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). Ability to prepare detailed technical documentation. Localization Commitment Localization is a strategic priority for Siemens in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, aligning with Vision 2030. Qualified Saudi national engineering professionals meeting the above qualifications are strongly encouraged to apply. Siemens is committed to developing local talent and building long-term engineering capability within the Kingdom. Application Process We invite interested candidates to submit their online application. Please ensure all applications are complete for consideration in the selection process.

Key Responsibilities Implement and follow policies for warehouse order management, ensuring flexible and efficient picking and loading to achieve timely and customer-focused deliveries. Maintain punctuality in receiving, issuance, and dispatching operations according to agreed cut-off times. Participate in and implement Quality Assurance policies and strategies. Contribute to the development of the area's yearly expenses budget and manage it daily. Manage ambient and cold store operations to maximize warehouse resource utilization. Maintain accurate inventory records and a sustainable inventory control and management system for both cold and ambient stores. Monitor stock levels, follow up on deliveries, and manage the Materials Requirement Planning (MRP) process. Ensure minimum work conditions for all warehouse employees in both cold and ambient stores. Train and educate the operations team on company policies and procedures. Implement Health, Safety, and Environmental programs for cold and ambient stores. Promote the BRF corporate management culture within the team and motivate employees. Develop, manage, and routinely follow up on inventory integrity procedures and results to ensure on-time accuracy between book and physical stock. Implement corporate Quality Assurance policies for products across all warehouse processes. Plan and manage weekly operation projections (stock, inbound, outbound) to ensure proper resource planning in advance. Develop, implement, adapt, and manage operation policies and procedures to optimize resource utilization and minimize risks. Define and establish a routine management system for KPIs, with clear responsibilities, authorities, and metrics. Attend meetings with Procurement, Maintenance, and other relevant departments. 5fe2b854a23f4c07.description: Job description About the job MACHINERY OUTFITTING ENGINEER (CS) We are seeking an experienced Machinery Outfitting Engineer (Construction Support – CS) with 5–10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing technical and engineering support to shipyard production teams, resolving machinery outfitting-related design issues, reviewing installation arrangements, and ensuring engineering accuracy, constructability, and compliance with project specifications and applicable marine standards. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide construction and technical engineering support for machinery outfitting activities in marine and shipbuilding projects. Review, update, and revise machinery outfitting engineering deliverables, including machinery arrangement and equipment layout drawings, machinery space layouts and equipment positioning plans, machinery foundations, seating arrangements, and supporting structures, machinery installation and interface drawings, equipment access, maintenance clearance, and servicing arrangements, production, fabrication, and installation drawings, 2D engineering drawings and 3D machinery outfitting models Review engineering drawings, shop drawings, and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve design-related issues. Provide technical support to shipyard production teams during machinery installation, assembly, and construction activities. Resolve technical queries (TQs), engineering discrepancies, installation issues, and machinery outfitting-related production problems. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into drawings and 3D models. Coordinate with Hull Structure, Piping, HVAC, Electrical, Instrumentation, and other outfitting disciplines to ensure proper design integration and avoid clashes. Review vendor drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation to ensure compatibility with machinery arrangements and installation requirements. Verify machinery foundations, equipment seating, supporting arrangements, and installation clearances against approved engineering requirements. Ensure machinery outfitting drawings and installation arrangements comply with project specifications, applicable classification society rules, marine standards, and shipyard construction requirements. Participate in constructability reviews and identify potential design conflicts, installation constraints, and access limitations before execution. Review site and production feedback and recommend appropriate engineering modifications to facilitate installation and construction activities. Coordinate with engineering teams, equipment vendors, and production personnel to ensure timely resolution of technical and installation-related issues. Maintain updated engineering drawings, technical records, and documentation in accordance with project procedures. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final installation and production modifications, where required. Ensure construction support engineering deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. KEY QUALIFICATIONS: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or an equivalent engineering discipline. 5–10 years of relevant experience in machinery outfitting engineering within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, or offshore vessel projects. Hands-on experience in Construction Support (CS), shipyard technical support, and engineering drawing modifications. Strong experience in machinery arrangements, equipment layouts, machinery foundations, equipment seating, and installation engineering. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other shipbuilding CAD software accepted by the client. Experience reviewing and modifying 2D production drawings, 3D models, equipment layouts, and machinery installation drawings. Good understanding of machinery installation requirements, equipment interfaces, foundation arrangements, maintenance clearances, and accessibility. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, vendor documentation, equipment specifications, shop drawings, and production mark-ups. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during construction and machinery installation activities. Familiarity with marine classification society rules, applicable shipbuilding standards, statutory requirements, and project specifications. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, Piping, HVAC, Electrical, Instrumentation, and other engineering disciplines. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Strong technical problem-solving, drawing interpretation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment. Providing Operative support to Production team Solving issues related to Shop Drawings and various Production Information ﻿VERTICAL ENGINEERING Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

5f0e3a91d26d43e7.description: About the Role Virtucruit is partnering with a leading mining company in Saudi Arabia to appoint a UG Shift Boss within the Mining Department. Ensure full compliance with safety procedures, ventilation requirements, and ground control standards. Coordinate drilling, blasting, mucking, and ore handling to achieve planned shift targets. Conduct toolbox talks, HSE awareness sessions, and on-field HSE meetings with staff and contractors. Lead on-site HSE training programs for field personnel. Improve reporting, recording, and investigation participation for unsafe acts/conditions and near-misses. Coordinate and participate in continuous auditing of HSE management systems. Assist the Administration and Occupational Health Team with all aspects of the post-accident/injury treatment process. Collaborate with operations and maintenance employees to promote the permit-to-work system and ensure safety. Identify non-compliant, incomplete, or substandard procedures for activities involving employees and/or contractors. Assist field staff and contractors with PPE care and inspection, ensuring compliance. Record and report all incidents, including employee injuries. Support Corporate HSE programs such as People Based Safety, 5S, and Zero Incident Process. Inspect equipment logbooks and records for scaffolding, ladders, cranes, tools, work equipment, and power tools. Support HSE incentive and promotional programs, including Safety Day, World Environment Day, and corporate HSE campaigns. Promote HSE Observation and Communication programs involving owner and contractor HSE officers. Inspect portable fire extinguishers and safety eye-wash/shower stations, maintaining records as required. Assist the HSE Engineer in the risk assessment process and maintenance of identified control measures. Support the Incident Controller as part of the emergency response team. Support Corporate Environmental programs such as waste management, plantation, and spill control. Support Corporate Occupational Health Programs including Get Healthy Stay Healthy, Stress Management, Quit Smoking Programs, and Diet and Exercise initiatives. Conduct regular walk-around checks to monitor HSE controls. Ensure the availability of first aid measures and firefighting equipment at locations, inspecting its condition. Collect environmental deviations and ensure identification and implementation of corrective actions. Coordinate HSE emergency drills and reports. Ensure continuous monitoring of work areas and the presence of controls for identified risks. Provide induction training to new employees, visitors, contractors, and subcontractors. Ensure the availability of medical facilities and medicines in the ambulance. Monitor the validity of equipment certifications and operator licenses. Perform other assigned HSE duties. A strong understanding of HSE management systems and a proactive approach to safety are essential. Work Environment The position involves working near moving mechanical parts and in outdoor weather conditions. Employees may occasionally work in high and precarious places and be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, toxic chemicals, electrical shock hazards, and other risks. The noise level in the work environment is typically moderate, though very loud conditions may occur. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia.

5f5a0ec5e77e61b6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة خليج مركبات الحلول لصيانة السيارات عن أمين صندوق كاشير للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى إدارة وتحصيل جميع المعاملات المالية اليومية النقدية والإلكترونية بدقة وكفاءة، مع ضمان مطابقتها للفواتير وتقديم خدمة موثوقة للعملاء. الهدف الوظيفي يتولى أمين الصندوق الكاشير مسؤولية إدارة وتحصيل كافة المعاملات المالية اليومية في الورشة، سواء كانت نقدية أو إلكترونية. يشمل ذلك مطابقة المبالغ مع فواتير صيانة السيارات وقطع الغيار المعتمدة، وضمان حفظ وتسوية السيولة النقدية وفقاً للسياسات المالية المتبعة، مع الالتزام بتقديم خدمة سريعة واحترافية لعملاء الورشة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام الفواتير المعتمدة من مسؤول الاستقبال أو موظف الصيانة والتأكد من مطابقة المبالغ والخدمات المدونة. تحصيل المبالغ المستحقة من العملاء عبر وسائل الدفع المختلفة، بما في ذلك النقد، بطاقات مدى/الائتمان، والتحويلات البنكية. إصدار إشعارات السداد وتزويد العميل بالفاتورة الضريبية وسند القبض الرسمي قبل تسليمه مفتاح المركبة. مطابقة المقبوضات اليومية (نقد وشبكة) مع إجمالي الفواتير الصادرة على برنامج إدارة الورشة (ERP). إعداد التقرير المالي اليومي لإغلاق الصندوق (Daily Cash Closure) وتسليم المقبوضات النقدية للمحاسب أو إيداعها في الحساب البنكي للشركة. الاحتفاظ بعهدة النقدية الصغيرة (Petty Cash) واستخدامها لتغطية المصروفات النثرية والتشغيلية الطارئة بناءً على موافقات معتمدة. التأكد من تصفية كافة الحسابات وتعلقات الدفع قبل السماح بإصدار تصريح خروج السيارات من الورشة. توثيق وأرشفة جميع السندات، الفواتير، ومستندات الدفع اليومية وتسليمها للقسم المالي. التعامل مع العملاء بأمانة واحترافية والرد على استفساراتهم المتعلقة بطرق الدفع والتفاصيل المالية للفاتورة. الالتزام التام بالتعليمات والأنظمة الضريبية، مثل متطلبات الزكاة والدخل والفلترة الإلكترونية (ZATCA). المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال أمين صندوق أو كاشير. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات المالية النقدية والإلكترونية بدقة. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع العملاء. الالتزام بالأنظمة المالية والضريبية. تفاصيل إضافية المدينة: الدمام. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب الشهري: يتراوح بين 3,750 و 5,625 ريال سعودي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مؤسسة خليج مركبات الحلول لصيانة السيارات.

5f6cbd4b2aee660e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة ذهب المعمار عن رسام هندسي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحويل المسودات والتصاميم الهندسية إلى رسومات دقيقة، سواء يدوياً أو باستخدام البرمجيات المتخصصة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمبتدئين في هذا المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قراءة وتفسير مسودات المخططات والتصاميم الهندسية والرسوم، ومناقشتها مع المهندس المختص لضمان الفهم الدقيق. رسم المخططات الهندسية والرسوم التنفيذية يدوياً باستخدام أدوات الرسم المخصصة. استخدام البرمجيات الهندسية على الحاسوب لرسم وتحرير المخططات والرسوم التنفيذية. تدقيق الرسومات وتقديمها للمهندس المختص، وإعداد الرسومات النهائية بناءً على التوجيهات. طباعة المخططات النهائية باستخدام برامج الحاسوب بالمقياس المطلوب. تصنيف وفهرسة وتوثيق وترتيب وحفظ المخططات الهندسية بشكل منهجي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الرسم الهندسي. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والتصاميم الهندسية. إتقان الرسم اليدوي واستخدام أدوات الرسم. القدرة على استخدام برمجيات الرسم الهندسي على الحاسوب. بيئة العمل يعمل الرسام الهندسي ضمن فريق عمل في مؤسسة ذهب المعمار بمدينة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مقر العمل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

5f8c3611da645271.job_title: AFCAP V : PSAB ESS Community Planner (Secret Clearance)
5f8c3611da645271.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Community Planner for the AFCAP V Saudi Arabia: PSAB ESS program. This full-time role is based at Prince Sultan Air Base (PSAB) in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) and requires a Secret Clearance. The successful candidate will provide essential community planning and management services for human and physical aspects of community, regional, urban, comprehensive, and land use plans, supporting the installation's development and operational effectiveness. Program Context The KBR PSAB Program delivers comprehensive Base Operating Support-Installation (BOS-I) services at Prince Sultan Air Base. These services support the 378 Air Expeditionary Wing (AEW), mission partners, and tenant units, including transient, temporary duty (TDY), permanent party, and rotational personnel. The program also extends its support to five remote Army sites within PSAB, ensuring seamless operations, maintenance, and support activities critical for sustained mission readiness. Key Responsibilities Facilitate the development and maintenance of the Installation Development Plan (IDP) and other comprehensive planning studies. Ensure compatible use planning between on-installation and off-installation facility, infrastructure development, and land use. Develop a regional and local vicinity perspective of conditions off the installation. Plan, program, budget, and execute required projects in support of assigned programs, utilizing cost estimating tools for government estimates. Collect data and evaluate factors affecting the physical development, maintenance, and management of installation infrastructure assets. Prepare planning studies and analyze quantitative and qualitative data. Function as an integral team member, cooperating with and supporting * deployed forces and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), sharing information as required. Ensure all contractual performance objectives are met and contractual submittals are provided to the government. Work effectively within a diverse, international, and multi-skill workforce. Be available within two hours of notification to meet with Government personnel on the installation, as required. Ensure the successful delivery of services to approximately 4,000 personnel at all times. Responsible for proper utilization, accounting, and safeguarding of all government and contractor-provided property. Ensure compliance with all US laws, Saudi Labor Law, Final Governing Standards (FGS), Overseas Environmental Baseline Guidance Document (OEBGD), Air Force Instruction (AFI), and local standards. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in community planning or a related field. Ability to manage activities related to human and physical aspects of community, regional, urban, comprehensive, and land use plans. Proficiency in preparing planning studies and analyzing quantitative and qualitative data. A Secret Clearance is required for this position. Work Environment and Physical Requirements The work environment includes both indoor and outdoor settings, with potential exposure to heat, cold, dust, noise, and chemicals. Overtime and shift work may be required based on contractual needs, along with occasional to frequent travel. Employees must adhere to all Federal, State, and Local regulations, Company work rules, and written instructions. Task-specific work environment training will be provided. Physical requirements include lifting up to 35 lbs, team lifting up to 50 lbs, climbing, extended sitting or standing, stooping, stretching, and bending. Individual Protective Equipment (IPE), including Level III plus/IV Individual Body Armor with ballistic plates, ACH helmet, and reflective vests, may also be necessary. Day-to-day activities may involve standard office tasks, as well as moderate to heavy physical exertion including walking to operating areas and climbing stairs.

5fa3a8e7e3a3be92.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo is a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, with products enjoyed by consumers in over 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated more than $79 billion in net revenue through a diverse portfolio that includes iconic brands such as LAY’S®, DORITOS®, CHEETOS®, GATORADE®, PEPSI®, and QUAKER®. 5fbf7a655e66e8a3.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Construction Manager – Commercial Zone to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The Construction Manager will operate in a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) capacity, managing multiple contractors and ensuring compliance with project objectives on behalf of the client. Key Responsibilities Review and provide input on master construction schedules, phasing plans, and milestones for commercial components. Coordinate with design consultants to ensure construction feasibility and completeness of drawings/specifications. Lead day-to-day site management of commercial blocks, coordinating with the main contractor, specialized subcontractors, and suppliers. Ensure construction aligns with approved drawings, specifications, and client standards. Conduct and/or participate in safety audits, toolbox talks, and incident investigations. Promote a safety culture on site, particularly in high-risk commercial activities. Act as the primary PMC interface between the client, consultants, and contractors for commercial works. Coordinate and manage interfaces between project parties. Oversee testing and commissioning of building systems serving commercial areas. Coordinate integrated testing of systems across mixed-use zones. Lead snagging, pre-handover inspections, and progressive handover of commercial spaces to the client/tenants. Proven experience working in a PMC environment or with leading project management firms. Required Skills Strong knowledge of building construction techniques (RC, steel, façade). Experience in commercial interiors and retail fit-out coordination. Familiarity with MEP systems relevant to commercial developments. Knowledge of local building regulations, fire codes, and authority approval processes. Strong leadership and team management skills on multidisciplinary, multi-contractor sites. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities. High level of technical problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Ability to manage multiple work fronts and prioritize under time and cost constraints. Strong reporting and documentation skills with attention to detail. Commitment to safety, quality, and ethical project delivery. Work Location This position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with potential work in Jeddah.

5fe59d3ffad25429.description: About the Role Omega Talent is conducting a confidential search for a Group Chief Financial Officer on behalf of an established organization with a diverse portfolio of businesses. 5fb621761275e94d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة نبت للمقاولات عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق الحسابات وإعداد التقارير المالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في المجال المحاسبي. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المهام المحاسبية يشمل الدور إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. كما يتضمن إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات الضرورية. يتولى المحاسب أيضاً إعداد وحفظ التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. معرفة قوية بالمبادئ والمعايير المحاسبية. القدرة على إعداد وتحليل التقارير المالية. مهارات ممتازة في تنظيم الوثائق وحفظها. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة نبت للمقاولات. تلتزم المؤسسة بتوفير بيئة عمل مهنية تدعم التطوير المستمر للموظفين في مجال المحاسبة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

5faa2934424573ca.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة في مشاريع الترميم والمحافظة على الممتلكات. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم المعمارية لمشاريع الإنشاءات المختلفة. إدارة فريق التصميم فيما يتعلق باختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية. إعداد النماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات الفنية والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والمواد الإنشائية المناسبة. تقديم الدعم الفني لمشاريع الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل المباني القائمة. الخبرة في تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في التصميم المعماري وإعداد الرسومات والنماذج. القدرة على إدارة فريق التصميم وتوجيهه. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم للمشاريع والتنسيق مع المقاولين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والاحتفاظ بالسجلات. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي، ومقر العمل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب الالتزام بمتطلبات المشاريع الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

5f20695f96078046.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Procurement Director to lead procurement operations across our residential projects portfolio. This leadership role requires strategic oversight of procurement activities, focusing on delivering high-quality materials and services while optimizing cost and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and manage procurement strategies aligned with the company’s residential project goals. Oversee procurement planning, sourcing, contract negotiation, and supplier relationship management. Collaborate closely with project teams and other departments to forecast procurement needs and ensure timely delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in procurement processes to enhance efficiency, reduce risk, and maximize value. Maintain compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies, including sustainability and local content requirements. Lead and mentor the procurement team to achieve operational excellence and foster professional growth. Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and industry innovations to capitalize on new opportunities. Prepare and present procurement reports and metrics for senior management and stakeholders. Promote ethical sourcing and corporate social responsibility throughout procurement activities. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related disciplines; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum 10-15 years of progressive procurement experience, preferably in large-scale residential construction or real estate projects. Demonstrated expertise in procurement strategy development and execution. Strong negotiation skills and experience managing complex supplier contracts. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities. Proficiency with procurement software and data analytics tools. Knowledge of local content regulations and sustainability initiatives is a plus. Fluent in English; Arabic language skills are an advantage.

5f218ec34900eddd.description: About Informa PLC and Tahaluf Informa PLC is a global events organiser. Tahaluf is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF). Tahaluf operates as the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia. The company organises events such as LEAP, Cityscape, Black Hat MEA, and CPHI Middle East. This position is based in Riyadh and is offered on a contract basis. Role Summary The Senior Marketing Executive will be responsible for developing and executing multi-channel marketing strategies for two life science and pharmaceutical events: CPHI Middle East and BIO Middle East. The primary objective is to drive attendance, increase exhibitor ROI, and establish these events within the regional pharma calendar. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end marketing cycle, covering awareness, interest, conversion, and retention for both events. Develop and implement data-segmentation strategies to target specific niches, including API manufacturers, biotech startups, government regulators, and big pharma C-suite executives. Manage the marketing budget, ensuring optimal return on investment across paid, earned, and owned channels. Generate Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) for the sales team through inbound marketing and targeted LinkedIn campaigns. Oversee the creation of whitepapers, webinars, and industry reports to position the events as thought-leadership platforms. Manage the deployment of automated email journeys using Eloqua to nurture prospects through the registration funnel. Act as the primary marketing liaison for local health authorities and trade associations. Negotiate barter agreements and manage relationships with key regional and international trade press. Collaborate with the operations team to ensure a consistent brand experience on the show floor. Provide weekly KPI reports on registration pacing and exhibitor MQLs. Required Experience Candidates should possess 3+ years of experience in a relevant marketing role, demonstrating proficiency in multi-channel marketing strategies and budget management. Work Type and Location This is a contract position located in Riyadh.

5f45a5890f4cd419.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المدن للتشغيل والصيانة عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة قوية ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم شامل لبرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. القدرة على متابعة التطورات التقنية وتطبيقها في بيئة العمل. مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة المشاريع. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المدن للتشغيل والصيانة في المنطقة الشرقية، ويوفر فرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع هندسية حيوية. التقديم للراغبين في التقديم، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

5f14478fa0e97fc4.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Multi Property Income Auditor Supervisor to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time position involves overseeing the accuracy of financial information and ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures related to cash handling and record keeping. The role requires a detail-oriented individual to manage auditing and reconciliation tasks across multiple properties. Key Responsibilities Verify the accuracy of figures, postings, and financial documents. Record, store, access, and analyze computerized financial information effectively. Control and secure cash and cash equivalents in accordance with established cash handling policies. Organize, secure, and maintain all files and records, adhering to document retention and confidentiality policies. Prepare, maintain, and distribute various statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables. Audit statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables for compliance and accuracy. Audit and reconcile all revenue postings across properties. Operational Duties Adhere to all company safety and security policies, reporting any accidents, injuries, or unsafe conditions. Ensure professional appearance and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and company assets. Maintain awareness of undesirable persons on property premises to ensure security. Communicate professionally and clearly with guests and colleagues, addressing service needs and assisting individuals with disabilities. Develop and maintain positive working relationships, supporting team goals and responding to employee concerns. Comply with all quality assurance expectations and standards. Perform physical tasks such as moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance. Execute other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Qualifications and Experience Education: High school diploma or *** equivalent is required. Related Work Experience: No specific related work experience is required for this position. Supervisory Experience: No prior supervisory experience is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, where the successful candidate will work within a dynamic environment, supporting financial operations across multiple properties for Marriott International. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join Marriott International and contribute to their financial operations team.

5f7cd62ea808ff98.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث معهد شبكة الأعمال الخليجية للتدريب عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، ووضع المعايير والإجراءات لضمان رضا العملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أخصائي خدمة العملاء مسؤولية تحديد مؤشرات الأداء ومعايير الجودة، والمشاركة في تطوير الإجراءات، وتحليل رضا العملاء، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. تشمل المهام التفصيلية ما يلي: إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء، والمتابعة المستمرة لضمان سير العمل. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات لتعظيم جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف بناء نموذج متكامل يلبي توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء لتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع خطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الكتابي والشفوي. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف. القدرة على تطوير البرامج والمبادرات لتحسين الجودة. مهارات إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. التعاون والتنسيق الفعال مع الإدارات المختلفة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في معهد شبكة الأعمال الخليجية للتدريب، ويقع في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل ضمن فريق لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات خدمة العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

5ff59f4b7dacd9e9.description: About the Role Acwa China is seeking a Shift Charge Engineer to oversee overall plant operation activities during their assigned shift. This full-time position is based in Al Qassim, Qassim, and requires ensuring all plant activities are performed safely and efficiently, adhering to approved Standard Operating Procedures, quality standards, and operational requirements. Key Responsibilities Comply with all safety rules and regulations, maintaining full awareness of plant safety hazards. Ensure the plant operates according to established standards, minimizing risks to personnel, machinery, and materials, while adhering to safety and environmental standards. Coordinate all plant operations activities with other departments during the shift, ensuring compliance with safety rules and regulations. Manage the permit-to-work system, including issuing and canceling permits as authorized, and coordinating activities involving plant chemistry with the Chemist. Follow operational schedules to achieve targeted production availability safely and efficiently, coordinating all activities or changes in plant status with the Operations Manager. Make prompt decisions to correct abnormalities or disturbances and take corrective actions during emergencies. Supervise start-up checklists, interlock checks, protection tests, and non-routine activities such as preservation or acid cleaning. Monitor the overall plant status, summarize activities in the log book, and complete daily plant status reports. Prepare incident/accident reports and other required departmental reports, submitting them to concerned authorities within stipulated timeframes. Assist in the training and familiarization of new personnel within the shift. Study and propose modifications to improve plant efficiency. Ensure Environmental Aspect-Impact and Hazard Risk Assessments are conducted, controlled, and updated. Implement, monitor, and report on IMS objectives, targets, and programs. Report deviations in the Integrated Management System, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Ensure regulatory compliance within the scope of activities. Identify competency gaps for subordinate personnel and implement necessary actions. Provide on-the-job training to new employees and evaluate their performance. Communicate with the Load Dispatch Center. Qualifications and Experience Familiarity with plant O&M agreements, P&IDs, SOPs, Work Instructions, Operation and control logics, emergency operation procedures, and regulatory requirements. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience. Ability to maintain staff evaluation records and vacation schedules. Proficiency in identifying, documenting, and controlling hazards in the assigned work area. Work Environment This role requires readiness to work in a remote location within Al Qassim.

5f102a8bd18d6f26.description: About the Role Buro Happold Engineering is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join its Buildings team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves contributing to complex, high-profile projects through integrated, sustainable, and high-performance building-services design. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Context and Impact As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will hold a key technical and delivery position within the Riyadh Buildings team. You will lead the design and coordination of electrical building-services systems across various projects, supporting delivery from early concept and feasibility through detailed design, construction, and handover. This role involves collaboration with multidisciplinary design teams, architects, contractors, and clients, focusing on performance, sustainability, occupant comfort, future flexibility, and whole-life value. Key Responsibilities Lead the electrical design of building-services systems for new-build, refurbishment, and mixed-use developments. Develop coordinated electrical design solutions across all project stages, including concept, schematic, detailed design, tender, and construction support. Design and specify low-voltage power distribution, lighting, emergency lighting, small power, earthing and lightning protection, standby power, UPS systems, and ELV/ICT interfaces as applicable. Produce and review electrical calculations, technical reports, specifications, drawings, schedules, and design documentation. Ensure electrical systems are integrated with architectural design, building fabric, and the wider MEP strategy to support high-performing, energy-efficient internal environments. Coordinate with mechanical, public health, sustainability, and specialist consultants to resolve interfaces and deliver fully coordinated designs. Apply relevant Saudi Arabian, regional, and international codes, standards, and authority requirements throughout the design process. Support energy-conscious design decisions, including the evaluation of alternative systems, energy-saving opportunities, lifecycle considerations, and future adaptability. Lead technical reviews, quality assurance processes, and design risk management for electrical deliverables. Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and day-to-day support to graduate and junior engineers. Attend client, design-team, and site meetings; communicate design intent, technical risks, opportunities, and solutions. Review contractor submittals, shop drawings, material proposals, and technical queries during construction-stage services. Support project planning, resource coordination, programme management, and commercial delivery within agreed scope, fee, and timescales. Contribute to the continued development of Buro Happold’s technical excellence, design culture, and knowledge-sharing across the Buildings practice. Required Experience and Skills Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role requires sound engineering judgment, strong technical capability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving within a multidisciplinary design environment. Work Environment Buro Happold values flexible working patterns and welcomes applications from individuals seeking flexibility in their careers. The company is committed to diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Please communicate any adjustments needed for the application process to ensure accessibility.

5fd56f1b70091598.description: About the Role Amadeus is seeking a PMO Saudia eXPerience Studio in Jeddah. This full-time role is responsible for structuring, monitoring, and enhancing project governance, ensuring consistency, transparency, and efficiency across all value streams and initiatives. The position drives planning, reporting, risk management, and operational excellence, enabling informed decision-making and secure delivery commitments. Key Responsibilities Define and implement governance frameworks for project tracking and reporting. Structure planning cycles, milestones, and execution follow-up. Ensure consistency of processes across all value streams and act as a reference point for best practices within the PMO domain. Consolidate and track progress, risks, and dependencies across initiatives. Provide clear, structured reporting to stakeholders and ensure alignment with business needs. Ensure data quality and reliability of reporting tools while supporting continuous improvement of reporting standards. Identify cross-stream risks and dependencies and assess their impact on delivery. Drive mitigation actions and escalation when required, anticipating potential delivery issues. Support teams in proactively managing risks and interdependencies across initiatives. Continuous Improvement Improve tools, templates, and ways of working to increase efficiency and consistency. Promote project management best practices and contribute to the maturity of the operating model. Act as a change driver by supporting process enhancements and cross-functional alignment. The company fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being, providing attractive compensation packages including salary, bonus, caregiving, and health benefits. Amadeus embraces a flexible working model and is committed to a diverse and inclusive community, ensuring a culture of belonging and fair treatment. Trust and reliability are fundamental to the company's relationships with customers, partners, and employees.

5f2aa7d0fd49859a.description: About the Role Amadeus is seeking a Senior Data Engineering Expert to lead the design, development, modernization, and governance of enterprise-scale data platforms and data integration ecosystems. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with locations in Jeddah and Makkah, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role focuses on the Airline IT domain, supporting airline operations, customer experience, revenue management, commercial analytics, and regulatory reporting. Key Responsibilities Define and implement enterprise-wide data architecture strategies supporting commercial, digital, customer, and operational business functions. Design scalable, resilient, and secure data platforms for analytics, reporting, machine learning, and operational decision-making. Lead the modernization of legacy data environments towards cloud-native Lakehouse architectures and enterprise data ecosystems. Establish data engineering standards, architectural principles, governance frameworks, and best practices. Design and implement scalable enterprise data architectures supporting Airline Commercial and Digital functions, including Reservations, Revenue Management, Loyalty Programs, CRM, CDP, Digital Engagement, Customer Analytics, and Commercial Performance. Architect and develop scalable data ingestion, transformation, and serving layers for batch and real-time processing. Design reusable and metadata-driven ETL/ELT frameworks for large volumes of transactional, operational, and customer data. Establish enterprise integration patterns using APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging technologies, and hybrid connectivity models. Implement data quality controls, reconciliation mechanisms, lineage tracking, metadata management, and observability capabilities. Drive automation of deployment, orchestration, monitoring, recovery, and operational support processes. Design and implement streaming architectures for near real-time operational visibility and business insights. Enable event-driven data processing capabilities supporting customer engagement, disruption management, and operational performance monitoring. Establish enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) strategies and governance frameworks. Define and govern master data domains including customers, flights, airports, aircraft, crew, and enterprise reference data. 5ff951f2e01554a1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ديم عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ ومراقبة إجراءات وسياسات الموارد البشرية المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين، الإجازات، وتحديث البيانات، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان التطبيق الفعال والسلس لجميع سياسات وإجراءات عمليات الموارد البشرية، بما في ذلك مراقبة الحضور، إدارة الإجازات، وتوثيق بيانات الموظفين. كما يساهم الأخصائي في تقديم الدعم للموظفين من خلال معالجة استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بمختلف أنواعها، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية، المرضية، الطارئة، وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات، الإعارة، وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع البيانات مثل الترقيات، الدورات التدريبية، والمسائل المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. القدرة على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام الموظفين. فهم عميق لسياسات وإجراءات الإجازات المختلفة (مرضية، طارئة، سنوية). مهارات ممتازة في التعامل مع شكاوى واستفسارات الموظفين بمهنية. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة وحفظها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الأخصائي ضمن فريق عمليات الموارد البشرية لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.
